column1: # Places config/overlays/functions.tsv folds into a function by its fingerprint whose code differs
# from it in a constant, field offset, or call/global identity: each gets its own function.
# Implementations use existing decompiled C or host/variants.c. Compare retail places word by word.
# UpdatePad(void) loads a data address, unlike the sound wrapper's callback address.
# All 19 copies match func_00218908 instruction-for-instruction except the relocated jal.
# The catalogue folds three accessors into func_L00_0025D390: each returns a block a moby with
# mode bit 0x20 keeps a pointer to in its variables. They differ in the pointer's place: +0 (the
# hit reaction block), +0x10 and +8 (the platform block: what a moby carries its riders with).
# Read from the last load of each copy in all 19 levels.
# func_00216270 is func_0012F068(func_002177F0); 25 other places of the same shape load another
# address and call another function: func_L00_002864E0's wrapper in every level, six of one level.
